title: Design-Build for Fresh Pond Yard Bridge and Track Reconfiguration
short_description: Design-build procurement for a replacement railroad bridge and track reconfiguration in Queens.
project_location: Fresh Pond Yard, Glendale, Queens, New York, USA
project_scope: Design and construction of a new off-line replacement railroad bridge and associated track reconfiguration at Fresh Pond Yard. The notice indicates a railroad bridge within a rail yard setting, but provides no technical data such as span lengths, bridge type, track lengths, or structural dimensions.
services: Two-step design-build contract including design and construction services; requested disciplines include design-build/developer, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Replacement railroad bridge is generally relevant to sbp, especially where structural engineering is required.
- Tender includes an explicit planning component within a design-build model, not pure construction only.
- Structural engineering is specifically requested, indicating meaningful engineering scope.
- Rail yard bridge and track reconfiguration may involve operational constraints and phased construction, increasing complexity.
- However, no span, structural system, or special architectural/innovative features are stated, limiting certainty about structural ambition.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available information for a rough estimate: design-build contract for a new off-line replacement railroad bridge and track reconfiguration at Fresh Pond Yard in Queens, including structural, geotechnical, and traffic-related design. Without span, track quantity, staging requirements, utility impacts, or site constraints, no realistic USD estimate can be derived from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a design-build procurement, any structural engineering fee for sbp would depend on team role, bridge size and complexity, track works extent, geotechnical scope, and design phase responsibilities; the notice does not provide enough detail for a reliable estimate.
references_qualifications: Qualified design-builder sought through a two-step RFP process. Requested disciplines include design-build/developer, geotechnical engineering, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
award_criteria: Two-step RFP/RFQ process for selection of a qualified design-builder. Specific award criteria or weighting are not stated in the source excerpt.
